title: Large-Scale Application / Color Transitions
slide_intent: Design transitions as part of the spatial experience so changes between states remain coherent at architectural scale.
strategic_value: Related color fills and current lines can keep Spectrum present even when the lobby display changes composition.
demonstration: A 65.70-second triptych alternates dark current fields with broad blue, green and warm color planes. Small logo signatures remain near the bottom of the screens.
practical_value: Compare how line motion and broad color wipes change the room’s visual intensity.

content_islands.name: Lobby setting
content_islands.spec: Keep the same three screen recesses, white room, reflected floor and human scale figure.

content_islands.name: Transition sequence
content_islands.spec: Alternate dark line fields with diagonal color planes and saturated full-screen states, retaining small Spectrum signatures during branded dark states.

ingredient.name: Lobby transitions
ingredient.role: Connect successive screen states through color and movement.
ingredient.application: Use the case study’s expanded installation palette and transitions in relation to the hero current sequence.
ingredient.scope: Large lobby screens. The agency cites art and architectural references; no universal transition duration or easing rule is published.
